title: Recipe 45 — DAO governance crew (parallel analysts, one vote)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Six analysts read the proposal in parallel; one recommendation comes out; the vote is a separate, gated phase.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the credentials
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — six roles means six times the model spend.

beats.label: Type the dao-voter crew
beats.cue: “Triage, treasury impact, technical risk, legal, governance history, recommendation. Each is a role, not a prompt section.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Lint's graph-crew well-formedness pass catches a role nobody routes to — before you pay six models to find out.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN. Six analyst modules, an orchestrator, and a daemon — all emitted, all installed, all booting.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the declared credentials gate

beats.label: List what the compiler emitted
beats.cue: “One file per analyst. You can read any single one of them without reading the others.”

verify.note: one module per role plus the orchestrator

beats.label: Read the file list
beats.cue: “Six analysts, one orchestrator, one daemon. That is the crew, on disk.”

beats.label: Open the orchestrator
beats.cue: “The fan-out and the join are ordinary code. No scheduler, no engine.”

groups.title: Beat 3 · the vote is not the analysis

beats.label: Boot with nothing configured
beats.cue: “The vote phase is chain-gated and fails closed — analysis is cheap, casting a vote is not.”
beats.command: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN bun live/dist/daemon.ts > live/gate.log 2>&1

verify.note: exit 2 — the daemon names the missing env gate and starts nothing

groups.title: One more thing · run the crew

beats.label: Boot the crew
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Feed it a real proposal and watch the six analysts come back before the recommendation does.”

verify.note: six parallel model calls per proposal, plus chain credentials for the vote phase

beats.label: Read the injection defense
beats.cue: “Proposal text is attacker-controlled. The recipe treats it as data at the boundary — Pillar 3, applied to governance.”
